items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Okay, so we became great friends

ctx.x: Ben was playing piano for the silent pictures in the moviehouse.

And he could really play. This cat was a great piano player. And that's all he played. Well, I learned later that he had studied a little fiddle for a while, but I mean -- but really, piano was his instrument.

items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: we'd call him the Bean. Instead of Egghead, you know, we called him the Bean

ctx.x: Because he was so intelligent about music and the way he could play and the way he could think and the way his chord progressions run, we'd call him the Bean. Instead of Egghead, you know, we called him the Bean, you know.
Like Egghead, that's how he got that name.
